## Affected callers
- Policy discovery calls `resolve_call`, converts its outcome to `SemanticInputStatus`, and caches the result by durable call key (`crates/bifrost-policy/src/taint_policy.rs:1382`); it merges that status into each retained call binding (`crates/bifrost-policy/src/taint_policy.rs:1444`). This consumes the result from `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:699`.
- Source-position dispatch delegates each located call to `resolve_call`, accumulates outcome quality, and derives aggregate coverage from the returned results (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/source.rs:236`); those results include the filtered call gap from `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:687`.
- ICFG `call_transfers` reaches `resolve_call` through its forwarding implementation, then maps dispatch candidates and boundaries into transfers and call boundaries (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:921`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:942`); it consumes the dispatch assembled after gap filtering (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:819`).

## Paths
- Exact-location lookup supplies target declarations, which are grouped by callable identity before entering the materialization queue (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:195`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:261`); the concrete hierarchy query uses each queued group's representative (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:551`).
- Materialization reuses a per-source-file outcome cache and sets `complete_materialization` for a `Complete` artifact (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:344`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:370`); the hierarchy query is reached when that artifact also matched a procedure (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:519`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:547`).
- The concrete branch charges one execution traversal before consulting the hierarchy (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:548`). `SemanticRequest::staged` shares the execution budget with its parent, and traversal charging returns true when no execution budget is attached (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/provider.rs:641`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/provider.rs:662`).
- Bodyless declarations reach the same hierarchy helper through a separate branch that retains an `Unmaterialized` boundary and queues implementors as `Unproven` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:596`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:631`); concrete declarations consult that helper at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:549`.

## Value flow
- `virtual_dispatch_implementor_targets` calls the analyzer's member-family provider; it returns `None` for non-functions, recorded native methods, or no provider (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:931`). These values reach the `None` arm that clears the absence flag (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:572`).
- `MemberFamilyAnswer::is_proven` compares the outcome with `Proven` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/member_family.rs:146`). The hierarchy helper builds `targets` from `ImplementedBy`/`OverriddenBy` edges when `is_proven()` holds and as `Vec::new()` otherwise, then returns `Some(targets)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:945`). The concrete branch matches that return value against the arms `Some(overrides) if overrides.is_empty()`, `Some(overrides)` and `None` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:554`).
- A nonempty hierarchy answer clears the absence flag and queues overrides only when `concrete_overrides` is enabled (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:559`). The oracle inherits that setting from the workspace (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle.rs:51`); its environment constructor reads the presence of `BIFROST_CHA_CONCRETE_OVERRIDES` once (`crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/config.rs:71`).
- A gap retained by the filter is passed to `apply_dynamic_dispatch_gap`, which adds an unresolved or truncated boundary and returns dispatch quality (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:709`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:2084`); gaps excluded at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:699` do not contribute to `gap_exceeded`.
- The filtered dispatch outcome reaches binding status through policy discovery (`crates/bifrost-policy/src/taint_policy.rs:1444`); status merging gives `Unknown` and `Unproven` precedence over `Complete` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/dataflow/input.rs:99`). The plan requires complete status and exhaustive coverage for binding completeness, then uses that map to refine unknown snapshots (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/value_flow/plan.rs:783`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/value_flow/plan.rs:808`).
- Java method-invocation lowering emits an `Unknown` `DynamicDispatch` gap scoped to the call site (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/semantic/control.rs:1996`). The scoped selector chooses a dispatch-impacting gap at that call point (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:2019`), and the predicate tests its capability together with candidate presence and the two hierarchy flags (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:1087`).
rationale: Reworded the is_proven/helper item to describe plainly how `targets` is built in each branch and that the concrete caller matches the return value against its three arms, removing the 'both empty-vector routes enter the empty arm' convergence the judges matched; anchors are unchanged.
